model.rawSql:
WITH rooms AS (SELECT time, station, sensor, name, temp_c, humidity_pct FROM indoor WHERE time >= now() - interval '10 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT time, station, sensor, name, temp_c, humidity_pct FROM channel WHERE time >= now() - interval '10 minutes'),
rh AS (SELECT station, sensor, last_value(name ORDER BY time) AS room,
  last_value(humidity_pct ORDER BY time) AS rh FROM rooms GROUP BY station, sensor),
vent AS (SELECT station, sensor, last_value(dewpoint_delta_c ORDER BY time) AS delta
  FROM ventilation WHERE time >= now() - interval '10 minutes' GROUP BY station, sensor)
SELECT rh.station, rh.sensor, rh.room,
  vent.delta AS value
FROM rh JOIN vent ON vent.station = rh.station AND vent.sensor = rh.sensor

WITH rooms AS (SELECT time, station, sensor, name, temp_c, humidity_pct FROM indoor WHERE time >= now() - interval '10 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT time, station, sensor, name, temp_c, humidity_pct FROM channel WHERE time >= now() - interval '10 minutes'),
vent AS (SELECT DISTINCT station, sensor FROM ventilation WHERE time >= now() - interval '10 minutes')
SELECT r.station, r.sensor, last_value(r.name ORDER BY r.time) AS room,
  last_value(r.humidity_pct ORDER BY r.time) AS value
FROM rooms r JOIN vent ON vent.station = r.station AND vent.sensor = r.sensor
GROUP BY r.station, r.sensor

annotations.description: Airing would leave the rooms at a median of 65% humidity or more, and at least 5 points damper than they are (less is within the sensors' error), for 30 minutes, while no room would be dried by airing (which Good time to air announces instead): the outside air holds more moisture than theirs.

model.rawSql:
SELECT station, avg(CASE WHEN aired THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS value
FROM house WHERE time >= now() - interval '40 minutes'
GROUP BY station

SELECT station, avg(humidity_pct) AS value
FROM house WHERE time >= now() - interval '10 minutes'
GROUP BY station

SELECT station,
  avg(CASE WHEN time >= now() - interval '10 minutes' THEN dewpoint_c END)
  - avg(CASE WHEN time < now() - interval '50 minutes' THEN dewpoint_c END) AS value
FROM derived WHERE sensor = 'outdoor' AND time >= now() - interval '70 minutes'
GROUP BY station

SELECT station,
  avg(CASE WHEN time >= now() - interval '10 minutes' THEN humidity_pct END)
  - min(humidity_pct) AS value
FROM house WHERE time >= now() - interval '2 hours'
GROUP BY station

annotations.summary: The windows look open and the air coming in is getting damper: the rooms are at {{ printf "%.0f" $values.B.Value }}% humidity and following it up. Close the windows.
annotations.description: The house has read as aired (its rooms sharing the outdoor air) for most of 40 minutes, with the rooms at a median of 65% humidity or more, for 10 minutes, while the outdoor dew point has risen 0.7 °C or more in an hour or the rooms have climbed 4 points or more above their lowest in 2 hours. Airing longer only lets the house follow the outside air up.

model.rawSql:
WITH rooms AS (SELECT time, station, sensor, name, temp_c, humidity_pct FROM indoor WHERE time >= now() - interval '6 hours' UNION ALL SELECT time, station, sensor, name, temp_c, humidity_pct FROM channel WHERE time >= now() - interval '6 hours')
SELECT station, sensor, last_value(name ORDER BY time) AS room,
  min(humidity_pct) AS value
FROM rooms
GROUP BY station, sensor
HAVING min(time) <= now() - interval '5 hours 50 minutes'

model.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT station, max(time) AS seen FROM station
  WHERE time >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY station)
SELECT d.station, d.sensor, last_value(d.name ORDER BY d.time) AS room,
  date_part('epoch', max(l.seen) - max(d.time))
    + last_value(d.unchanged_s ORDER BY d.time) AS value
FROM derived d JOIN latest l ON l.station = d.station
WHERE d.time >= now() - interval '7 days' AND d.unchanged_s IS NOT NULL
  AND (d.sensor IN ('indoor', 'outdoor') OR d.sensor LIKE 'ch%')
GROUP BY d.station, d.sensor

annotations.summary: {{ $labels.room }} has reported the same readings for {{ humanizeDuration $values.A.Value }}: its battery or radio has probably failed.
annotations.headline: These sensors have reported the same readings for 3 hours or more: a battery or radio has probably failed.
annotations.description: A room or outdoor sensor whose readings have not changed, or not arrived, for 3 hours of the station's reports. A console repeats a lost sensor's last values, so unchanged readings are how a lost one shows. Measured against the station's last report rather than the clock, so a station that stops uploading altogether does not flag every sensor; a sensor silent for more than 7 days drops out.

model.rawSql:
SELECT station, sensor, last_value(name ORDER BY time) AS room,
  CASE WHEN last_value(low ORDER BY time) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value
FROM battery
WHERE time >= now() - interval '10 minutes'
GROUP BY station, sensor

annotations.headline: These sensors' batteries are low.

  first_value(sea_hpa ORDER BY time) - last_value(sea_hpa ORDER BY time) AS value
FROM pressure
WHERE time >= now() - interval '3 hours'
GROUP BY station
HAVING min(time) <= now() - interval '2 hours 50 minutes'
